name: Explore, save, retain and remove a look
description: A visitor filters the collection and manages a saved look across reloads.
steps: Select ES in the header. Navigate to La colección and click Bob.
Confirm only The Miami Bob remains in the collection and click its Ver look button.
In the dialog click Guardar look, then Cerrar, then Mis looks.
Confirm The Miami Bob is in Tu selección. Close and reload the page.
Open Mis looks and verify The Miami Bob is retained. Click its Quitar button.
Confirm the empty-selection message, close and reload, then reopen Mis looks.
expected: The Bob filter shows one matching look, its details open, saving survives reload and removal survives another reload. The empty state provides a working collection link.

name: Use mobile navigation and retain the chosen language
description: A mobile visitor changes language, uses the compact menu and filters the catalog.
steps: Select EN in the header and refresh.
Confirm English navigation and Find your look remain visible.
Open Menu and choose The collection.
Click Waves. Confirm exactly Espresso Waves and Caramel Hours appear.
Switch to ES. Confirm Ondas remains selected and the same two products are visible.
Check no page-wide horizontal overflow and the header and catalog controls remain accessible.
expected: The language persists on reload. The mobile menu reaches the collection and closes; filtering and switching language preserve the chosen category without horizontal page overflow.

name: Find a recommended look and revise preferences
description: A visitor gets a caramel-wave match, then revises the quiz to a bob.
steps: Select EN and click Find your look in the hero.
Choose Long waves, Warm highlights and A special occasion.
Confirm Caramel Hours is recommended and the preference summary reflects all three choices.
Click Start again. Choose A sleek bob, then click Back.
Choose A sleek bob again, then Deep and dark and Every day.
Confirm The Miami Bob is recommended. Click View look, verify the matching product detail and close it using Escape.
expected: The three-step quiz recommends Caramel Hours for warm waves and The Miami Bob for a bob. Back and restart work, the result opens the matching detail and Escape closes the dialog.

name: Validate and retain a safe demo consultation
description: A mobile visitor prepares a consultation preview while the site clearly distinguishes it from a real booking.
steps: Select ES, open Prepara tu consulta and submit without a question.
Confirm a visible validation message and no summary.
Enter Dailin in Tu nombre, select Caramel Hours, and enter Quiero conocer este look y sus opciones. in the question field.
Create the sample consultation and verify the name, style and question appear in the summary with the notice that nothing was sent or booked.
Use Copiar resumen and verify either the copied confirmation or the visible manual-copy fallback.
Close, reload and reopen Prepara tu consulta.
expected: Blank questions are blocked. A valid preview safely displays the supplied details, never claims a sent message or booking, and the consultation fields persist after reload.

name: Browse the campaign images and read the demo information
description: A visitor explores the original campaign and sees transparent information about the concept website.
steps: Select EN and navigate to Moodboard.
Open the first campaign image and use Next to inspect another image, then Previous to return.
Use Previous from image 1 and confirm image 8 is shown. Close with Close.
Expand Can I purchase or book through this demo? in the FAQ.
Inspect the page images, scrolling the campaign strip as needed to load its images.
expected: The gallery shows legible individual images, next/previous wrap correctly and close works. The FAQ explains that no real purchases or appointments are processed; every displayed image loads from the fourteen bound campaign resources.
